vocabulary.meaning_en: who, what, when, where, why: the basic question words
vocabulary.meaning_ar: أسئلة W الخمسة (من، ماذا، متى، أين، لماذا)

vocabulary.meaning_en: in any place; it doesn't matter where
vocabulary.example: We can eat wherever you want.

vocabulary.meaning_en: any person; the person who (we don't know who)
vocabulary.example: Whoever broke the window must pay for it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: for what possible reason (strong emphasis, quite formal)
at any time; every time something happens
any thing; it doesn't matter what; also "I don't care" (slang)
vocabulary.note_ar: Whatever وحدها قد تبدو غير مهذّبة (لا يهمني)
vocabulary.note_en: "Whatever" alone can sound rude (I don't care).
vocabulary.example: You can do whatever you want.

vocabulary.meaning_en: any one from a choice; also "regardless which"

vocabulary.example: However you look at it, it's a good idea.
There is no restriction on time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word before a noun that shows which one (this, that, the)
it doesn't matter; without caring about something
vocabulary.example: She was going to be lost regardless of the road.
"Whatever you do, don't touch it!" uses emphasis.

fine_lines.title: question word vs question word + ever
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلمات السؤال (who, where, when, what) تسأل عن شيء محدد. عندما نضيف ever يصبح المعنى: بلا قيد، أي شخص/مكان/وقت/شيء، ولا يهم أيّ واحد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Question words (who, where, when, what) ask about something specific. Adding -ever means: no restriction, any person/place/time/thing; it doesn't matter which.

examples.sentence: Where do you want to eat?
I don't mind. Wherever you want.

fine_lines.title: whenever: any time vs every time
fine_lines.explanation_ar: whenever لها معنيان: (1) في أي وقت (لا يهم الوقت)، (2) كلما تكرر حدث (every time).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Whenever has two meanings: (1) at any time (time doesn't matter), (2) every time a repeated action happens.

examples.sentence: Come over whenever you want. (any time)
Whenever I eat spicy food, my stomach hurts. (every time)

fine_lines.title: whichever vs whatever
fine_lines.explanation_ar: whichever للاختيار من مجموعة محددة. whatever لأي شيء بدون حدود. أحيانًا يصح الاثنان.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Whichever is for choosing from a limited group. Whatever is any thing, with no limit. Sometimes both work.

examples.sentence: Choose whatever food you want for the party.

expressions.example: Where should I put this? Wherever you want.
I'll be home all night. Come over whenever you want.

expressions.meaning_en: Strong warning: you can do anything, but not this.
expressions.example: Whatever you do, don't touch that button!

expressions.meaning_en: Slang: I don't care (can be rude).

expressions.example: However you look at it, we need more time.

expressions.phrase: Whoever would do such a thing?
expressions.meaning_ar: مَن ذا الذي قد يفعل شيئًا كهذا؟
expressions.meaning_en: Showing surprise or anger about an unknown person.
expressions.example: Someone broke the window. Whoever would do such a thing?

grammar.title: -ever = no restriction
grammar.explanation_ar: إضافة ever إلى كلمات السؤال تزيل القيد: wherever = أي مكان، whoever = أي شخص، whenever = أي وقت، whatever = أي شيء، whichever = أي واحد من الخيارات، however = بأي طريقة.
grammar.explanation_en: Adding -ever to a question word removes the limit: wherever = any place, whoever = any person, whenever = any time, whatever = any thing, whichever = any one of the choices, however = in any way.
examples: Whoever finishes first can go home.
Call me whenever you need help.

grammar.title: -ever words as conjunctions and pronouns
grammar.explanation_ar: يمكن أن تربط هذه الكلمات جملتين (Wherever it's possible, leave some room)، ويمكن أن تحلّ محل الفاعل (Whoever did this must say sorry).
grammar.explanation_en: These words can join two ideas (Wherever it's possible, leave some room), and can act as the subject (Whoever did this must say sorry).
examples: Wherever it's possible, leave some space.
Whoever was responsible for the accident must pay.

grammar.title: Whatever and whyever for emphasis
grammar.explanation_ar: Whatever you do, don't... = تحذير قوي. Whyever would you...? = لماذا بحق؟ (أقوى من why وأكثر رسمية).
grammar.explanation_en: Whatever you do, don't... = a strong warning. Whyever would you...? = a stronger, more formal why.
examples: Whatever you do, don't open that door.
Whyever would you ask me that?

grammar.title: Two meanings of however and whichever
grammar.explanation_ar: however: (1) للتناقض بمعنى لكن، (2) بأي طريقة. whichever: (1) أي واحد تختاره، (2) بغض النظر أيّها.
grammar.explanation_en: However: (1) contrast, like but; (2) in any way. Whichever: (1) any one you choose; (2) regardless which one.
examples: Holidays are expensive; however, they are necessary.
However it was done, it wasn't done correctly.
She was going to be lost whichever road she took.

questions.question: ___ left the lights on must turn them off. (we don't know who)
You can come over ___ you want. I'll be home all night.
I don't care. Do ___ you want to do!
___ it was done, it wasn't done correctly. (in any way)
We can sit ___ you like. Any place is fine.
"Whenever I eat spicy food, my stomach hurts." Whenever means ___.
Choose the strongest warning:
choices: Whatever you do, don't touch it!
questions.explanation_ar: Whatever you do, don't = تحذير قوي.
questions.explanation_en: Whatever you do, don't = a strong warning.

questions.question: "Take ___ seat you like" (from these three seats).
When someone just says "Whatever." in an argument, it usually means ___.
